description: This file defines the HTMLPurifier_Zipper class, a data structure implementing a zipper for list manipulation, providing methods for moving within, modifying, and converting the list structure.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Zipper
classes.description: A class implementing a list zipper for efficient list manipulation with focus, supporting movement, insertion, deletion, and conversion operations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the zipper with front and back arrays.

methods.name: fromArray
methods.description: Creates a zipper from an array, placing a hole at the start and returning the zipper with the first element.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the zipper back into a normal array, optionally filling the hole with a specified value.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Moves the hole forward, filling it with a new element if provided.

methods.name: advance
methods.description: Advances the hole forward multiple times.

methods.name: prev
methods.description: Moves the hole backward, filling it if an element is provided.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the current element at the hole position and moves the hole forward.

methods.name: done
methods.description: Checks if the zipper has reached the end of the list.

methods.name: insertBefore
methods.description: Inserts an element before the hole.

methods.name: insertAfter
methods.description: Inserts an element after the hole.

methods.name: splice
methods.description: Replaces a number of elements at the hole with a new set of elements, returning the old elements and the new current element.
